1 who will get the Gutkha load from a train at New Delhi Railway Station platform no.3.
On the basis of information, a trap was laid at platform no.3, South Side of parcel godown Minto bridge New Delhi.
One person namely Sanjay Kumar s/o Udesh Singh aged 29 years was apprehended who was found 24 cartons of Gutkha containing tobacco mark as 'PADAM SHRI'.
On interrogation, Sanjay Kumar disclosed that he was worker of one Bhagwati Kumar.
Thereafter, accused Bhagwati Kumar was apprehended who confessed that he procures this gutkha from Hubli Karnataka and sends the same for sale in different states in India.
Thereafter, on the basis of complaint, present FIR was registered.
2. After the investigation, charge sheet was filed in the present case and cognizance for offence was taken.
3. Thereafter, present accused persons were summoned.

Copy of the State Vs.
Bhagwati Kumar (Convicted) 2/4 FIR No. 74-13 Crime Branch State Vs.
Bhagwati Kumar U/s 188 IPC & 59(1) F.S.S. Act, 2006 DOD:

23.09.2015 chargesheet was supplied to the accused persons in compliance of section 207 Cr.P.C and matter was kept for consideration on charge.
4. Today, argument on point of charge heard and charge u/s 59(1) of Food Safety &
Standard Act, 2006 & 188 IPC was framed against the accused persons to which they pleaded guilty.
The Court has warned the accused persons regarding consequences of pleading guilty.
However, both the accused persons insisted that they are pleading guilty without any fear and coercion and they are understanding the consequences of the plea of guilt.
In view of the plea of guilt of the accused persons, both of them are convicted for the offences as mentioned above.
ORDER ON SENTENCE 5.
Arguments on the point of sentence heard.
Record perused.
It has been submitted by Ld Counsel for convict that the convict Sanjay is 31 years old.
He is the only bread earner in his family and has family to support.
It is further submitted that he is a labourer and was acting on behalf of main convict Bhagwati Kumar and as such lenient view may be taken.
It is submitted on behalf of convict Bhagwati Kumar is 44 years old.
He has the family to support.
It is further prayer that lenient view may be taken.

After giving thoughtful consideration to the respectful submissions made on behalf of both the sides and considering the age of the convicts, their family circumstances, this court is of the view that interest of justice will be suitably met if the convict Bhagwati Kumar is sentenced to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/, in default of payment of fine to undergo SI for one month and convict Sanjay Kumar is sentenced to pay fine of Rs. 10,000/, in default of payment of fine to undergo SI for 15 days.
Ordered accordingly.
